description: This file defines the Adagrad optimizer class and related functional API for the PyTorch library, including implementation details for different optimization strategies and fused operations.

classes.name: Adagrad
classes.description: Implementation of the Adagrad optimizer class for PyTorch, supporting various configurations including fused and differentiable modes.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Adagrad optimizer with parameters such as learning rate, decay, weight decay, epsilon, and options for fused, differentiable, and maximize modes.

methods.name: __setstate__
methods.description: Restores the state of the optimizer, ensuring proper tensor types for the 'step' parameter.

methods.name: share_memory
methods.description: Shares the memory of the 'sum' tensors across processes for multiprocessing support.

methods.name: _init_group
methods.description: Initializes parameter groups, collecting parameters, gradients, and optimizer state, and checks for sparse or complex gradients.

methods.name: step
methods.description: Performs a single optimization step, updating parameters based on the Adagrad algorithm.
